snapshot: Stripe, Inc. (dual-headquartered in South San Francisco, California, United States, and Dublin, Ireland) is a privately owned financial technology company with a valuation of about $159 billion and over $1.9 trillion in payment volume processed in 2025, processing transactions for 5 million businesses in that year.

signals.text: Stripe brings AI-enabled checkout experience to Facebook.
Stripe launches its own subscriptions app on the Shopify App Store, competing with Recharge, Loop, and Shopify’s native tool.

suggested_opener: Open with: "Stripe brings AI-enabled checkout experience to Facebook." [s2] and ask what changed since.
